title: Great God! Where'er We Pitch Our Tent
description: Great God! Where'er We Pitch Our Tent in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 2 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 929 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Family Altar”, where the book credits them to Taylor's Collection.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Great God! wher-e'er we pitch our tent, Let us an al-tar raise, And there, with hum-ble frame, pre-sent Our sac-ri-fice of praise.

lines: Great God! where'er we pitch our tent,
And there, with humble frame, present
To thee we give our health and strength,
While health and strength shall last,

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
